name: Gloom Stalker Spells
description:
When you reach a Ranger level specified in the Gloom Stalker Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

Level 3: Disguise Self

Level 5: Rope Trick

Level 9: Fear

Level 13: Greater Invisibility

Level 17: Seeming
